instruction:
Write a Dockerfile for a PHP 8.3 Apache Laravel app.
- composer.json is present
- Port 80
output:
FROM php:8.3-apache
RUN docker-php-ext-install pdo_mysql mbstring opcache
COPY --from=composer:2 /usr/bin/composer /usr/bin/composer
WORKDIR /var/www/html
COPY . .
RUN composer install --no-dev --optimize-autoloader
RUN chown -R www-data:www-data storage bootstrap/cache
EXPOSE 80

instruction:
Write a Dockerfile for a PHP 8.2-FPM app with nginx.
- Two-stage: php-fpm + nginx
- Port 80
output:
FROM php:8.2-fpm
RUN docker-php-ext-install pdo_mysql
WORKDIR /var/www/html
COPY . .

FROM nginx:alpine
COPY --from=php:8.2-fpm /var/www/html /var/www/html
COPY nginx.conf /etc/nginx/nginx.conf
EXPOSE 80
CMD ["nginx", "-g", "daemon off;"]

instruction:

instruction:
Write a Dockerfile for a PHP 8.3 Symfony app.
- Uses composer
- Port 80
output:
FROM php:8.3-apache
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y git unzip
RUN docker-php-ext-install pdo_mysql
COPY --from=composer:2 /usr/bin/composer /usr/bin/composer
WORKDIR /var/www/html
COPY . .
RUN composer install --no-dev --optimize-autoloader
RUN mkdir -p var/cache var/log && chown -R www-data:www-data var
EXPOSE 80

instruction:
Write a Dockerfile for a PHP 8.3 Laravel app with a scheduler (cron).
- Port 80
output:
FROM php:8.3-apache
RUN docker-php-ext-install pdo_mysql
COPY --from=composer:2 /usr/bin/composer /usr/bin/composer
WORKDIR /var/www/html
COPY . .
RUN composer install --no-dev --optimize-autoloader

RUN chmod 0644 /etc/cron.d/laravel && crontab /etc/cron.d/laravel
EXPOSE 80

instruction:
Write a Dockerfile for a PHP 8.2 Laravel app using a multi-stage build to reduce final image size.
- Port 80
output:
FROM composer:2 AS builder
WORKDIR /app
COPY composer.json composer.lock ./
RUN composer install --no-dev --no-scripts
COPY . .
RUN composer dump-autoload --optimize

FROM php:8.2-apache
RUN docker-php-ext-install pdo_mysql
WORKDIR /var/www/html
COPY --from=builder /app /var/www/html
RUN chown -R www-data:www-data storage bootstrap/cache
EXPOSE 80

EXPOSE 80
